test_commands:
docker run --rm --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges:true -e AGENT_BROWSER_SOCKET_DIR=/tmp/ab $IMAGE_REF sh -ceu "uv --version && uv run --no-project python -c 'import bz2, ctypes, lzma, sys; assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 12)' && git --version && ssh -V && curl --version >/dev/null && jq --version && dig -v && docker --version && docker compose version && printf 'services:
  smoke:
    image: hello-world
' | docker compose -f - config >/dev/null && mise --version && mise exec github:coollabsio/coolify-cli@1.6.2 -- coolify --help >/dev/null && age --version && bun --version && wmill --version >/dev/null && /usr/src/app/windmill --version 2>&1 | grep -F 'Windmill v1.811.1' && mkdir -p /tmp/archive-out && printf smoke >/tmp/archive-input && tar -C /tmp -cf /tmp/archive.tar archive-input && tar -C /tmp/archive-out -xf /tmp/archive.tar && cmp /tmp/archive-input /tmp/archive-out/archive-input && zstd -q -c /tmp/archive.tar >/tmp/archive.tar.zst && zstd -q -d -c /tmp/archive.tar.zst | cmp - /tmp/archive.tar && agent-browser --version && agent-browser open 'data:text/html,<title>worker-ready</title>' && agent-browser get title | grep -Fx worker-ready && agent-browser close"
